description: Corrected calibration of each locus best score against the random-window maximum, and the power of the consensus-count test
code:
import numpy as np, json, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def rd(c): return open(f"out/{c}.fa").read().strip()
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))
MATS={k:(v[0],np.array(v[1])) for k,v in json.load(open("out/mats.json")).items()}
bg=rd("bg1")+rd("bg2")+rd("bg3")
lut=np.full(256,-1,np.int64)
for i,b in enumerate("ACGT"): lut[ord(b)]=i
def scores(seq,W):
    w=W.shape[1]; c=lut[np.frombuffer(seq.encode(),np.uint8)]; v=c>=0; c=np.where(v,c,0)
    n=len(seq)-w+1; s=np.zeros(n); ok=np.ones(n,bool)
    for j in range(w): s+=W[c[j:j+n],j]; ok&=v[j:j+n]
    s[~ok]=-999; return s
LOCI={"gcm":"gcm_win","pks1":"pks1_win","gatae":"gatae_win"}
rows=[]
for mid,(nm,W) in MATS.items():
    bs=np.concatenate([scores(bg,W),scores(rc(bg),W)]); bs=np.sort(bs[bs>-900]); n=len(bs)
    for loc,f in LOCI.items():
        sp=rd(f); N=len(sp)-W.shape[1]+1
        mx=float(max(scores(sp,W).max(),scores(rc(sp),W).max()))
        Flt=np.searchsorted(bs,mx,side="left")/n          # P(single score < observed max)
        p_ge=1.0-Flt**(2*N)                               # P(random window max >= observed)
        med=float(bs[min(n-1,int(np.ceil(n*0.5**(1/(2*N)))))])
        rows.append(dict(matrix=mid,tf=nm,locus=loc,bp=len(sp),observed_max=round(mx,2),
                         median_random_max=round(med,2),p_random_ge=round(p_ge,3)))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv("out/maxscore_calibration.csv",index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# consensus-level power: expected ATGCGGGY and ATGCGGRY counts in a 57,225 bp window
import json as js
r=js.load(open("out/bg_rates.json"))
for k in ["ATGCGGRY","ATGCGGGY"]:
    lam=r[k]*57225
    print(f"\n{k}: genomic rate {r[k]:.3e}/bp -> expected {lam:.2f} in 57,225 bp; P(0 observed) = {np.exp(-lam):.3f}")
print("\nP(random 57.2 kb window contains >=1 hit at p=1e-5) = %.3f"%(1-np.exp(-2*57218*1e-5)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.8))
locs=["gcm","pks1","gatae"]; mats=list(MATS); wdt=0.26
for i,m in enumerate(mats):
    sub=df[df.matrix==m].set_index("locus").loc[locs]
    ax.bar(np.arange(3)+(i-1)*wdt, sub.observed_max.values, wdt, label=f"{m} ({sub.tf.iloc[0]})")
    for j,(o,md) in enumerate(zip(sub.observed_max.values,sub.median_random_max.values)):
        ax.plot([j+(i-1)*wdt-wdt/2,j+(i-1)*wdt+wdt/2],[md,md],color="k",lw=2)
ax.plot([],[],color="k",lw=2,label="median best score of a random window of the same length")
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(["gcm\n51 kb\n(validated site)","pks1\n34.5 kb\n(validated site)","gataE\n57.2 kb\n(claim under test)"])
ax.set_ylabel("best PWM score in the locus (bits)"); ax.set_ylim(8,18)
ax.set_title("The best GCM match in gataE does not exceed what a random window of that size contains;\nthe two validated loci do",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc="lower left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
